Labour, every carry, hauling and all disposal fees live inside the one written figure — no hourly clocks, no weight charges, no surprises when the basement turns out deeper than remembered.

items.title: Free walkthrough cleanout quotes at your Aurora property
text: A crew at Live Junk Free lead walks the whole space — every room, the garage, the attic nobody’s opened — and writes one firm flat quote for clearing it all. The visit is free, the number binds only us, and there’s no pressure attached; cleanouts often follow hard seasons, and the decision timeline is yours.

items.title: Estate cleanouts handled the way family would
text: When a cleanout follows a loss, the contents aren’t junk — they’re a life. Our crews work slowly where it matters: photographs, documents, jewellery and anything that looks like it means something gets set aside for the family, not swept into a bin. You can be there for all of it, some of it, or none of it — whichever helps.

items.title: Hoarding and heavy cleanouts, judgment-free and discreet
text: Overwhelmed spaces get cleared with respect: no commentary, no spectacle, unmarked scheduling on request, and a steady room-by-room method that turns the impossible back into a home. We work with families, support workers and property managers alike — and the neighbours learn nothing from us.

items.title: Donation-first sorting — a full house shouldn't mean a full landfill
text: Cleanouts produce good things by the truckload, and ours go where they’re useful: furniture, housewares and clothing to donation partners, metals, appliances and e-waste to licensed recyclers, landfill strictly last. Documentation of the sorting is available whenever an estate or landlord file needs it.

items.title: Independent cleanout pricing — 30–50% under the franchise chains
text: The national brands carry head-office royalties in every cleanout quote. We’re locally owned with none — the plain reason identical whole-house cleanouts in Aurora invoice 30–50% lighter with us, with the same insurance and more care.

blocks.text: HOW OUR CLEANOUTS WORK
The Aurora Cleanout Process — Four Steps From Full House to Fresh Start

c: Paced to the job, gentle where it needs to be:

items.title: 1. Book Your Aurora Cleanout Walkthrough
text: Two minutes at +1 647 922 5865 — or online — sets the visit. The crew lead tours the full property, listens to what the cleanout is for — an estate, a sale, a move, a fresh start — and writes one flat quote with the timeline that fits it.

items.title: 2. Set Aside What Matters, Approve the Cleanout Quote
text: Before anything moves, the keep-list gets honoured: family items, documents, valuables and anything flagged stays exactly where you want it. Then the written number is approved and the clearing begins — on your schedule, at your pace.

items.title: 3. The Cleanout Runs Room by Room, Sorted as It Goes
text: The crew works methodically — donations in one stream, recycling in another, true waste last — with floors protected, doorways padded, and anything meaningful that surfaces mid-job brought to you, never binned by default.

items.title: 4. Swept, Empty and Ready for the Next Chapter
text: The property hands back broom-swept — every room, the garage, the shed — with debris gone on our own trucks and donation or disposal documentation available for the estate, the landlord or the listing. Most single-space cleanouts finish same-day; whole homes finish on the promised date.

blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Aurora — Asked Kindly, Answered Honestly

items.q: How much do cleanout services cost in Aurora?
a: Truck volume sets it: small cleanouts from $125, whole homes scaling openly with the space their contents fill. The exact figure is written free at the walkthrough before anything moves — sorting, carrying, hauling and every disposal fee inside — and it holds to the invoice.

items.q: How do you handle an estate cleanout after a loss?
a: Gently, and at your pace. Keepsakes, photographs, documents and valuables get set aside for the family before and during the clearing — anything meaningful that surfaces comes to you, never a bin by default. You can be present throughout, drop in, or leave it entirely with us; families choose all three.

items.q: Why are your cleanout rates 30–50% below the national brands?
a: No franchise royalty inside the quote — we’re local and independent, with our own trucks and crews. The identical cleanout, with more patience where it matters, simply costs less.

items.q: What if you find money, jewellery or important papers?
a: They come straight to you or the executor, every time. Cleanouts regularly surface cash in coat pockets, documents in drawers and jewellery in unlikely places — our crews are trained to slow down exactly there, and the find-and-set-aside habit is non-negotiable.

items.q: Is a hoarding cleanout really judgment-free?
a: Completely — it’s a working rule, not a slogan. No commentary, no photos beyond what you request, unmarked scheduling if wanted, and a steady room-by-room pace that respects the person as much as the property. We’ve cleared overwhelmed homes across Aurora; discretion is why we keep being called.

items.q: How long does a whole-house cleanout take?
a: Most single spaces — a garage, a basement, a locker — finish same-day. Full homes typically run one to three days depending on contents, with the schedule and the flat price both set at the walkthrough so the closing date or listing date never wobbles.

items.q: Can landlords book post-tenant and eviction cleanouts?
a: Yes — documented start to finish. Abandoned contents get photographed, the unit clears completely, and the space hands back swept and re-rentable, with lawful handling throughout and one invoice for the file. Portfolio arrangements welcome.
